description_en: Queries all endpoint information of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的所有连接地址信息
name: DescribeDBInstanceNetInfoForChannel

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: An internal parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: flag

parameters.help_en:
The type of endpoint to query. Valid values:
0 (default): regular endpoints.
1: read/write splitting endpoints of the shared database proxy
parameters.help_zh:
查询的连接地址类型：
0（默认）：常规连接地址。
1：共享代理的读写分离地址
parameters.name: db_instance_net_rw_split_type

DBInstanceNetInfo.description_en: The list of instance endpoint information

items.description_en: The details of instance endpoint information

Availability.description_en:
The availability status. Valid values:

Unavailable: unavailable.
Available: available
Availability.description_zh:
可用状态，取值：

Unavailable：不可用。
Available：可用

ConnectionStringType.description_en:
The type of the endpoint. Valid values:

Normal: regular endpoint.
ReadWriteSplitting: read/write splitting endpoint of the shared database proxy
ConnectionStringType.description_zh:
连接地址类型，取值：

Normal：普通连接地址。
ReadWriteSplitting：共享代理的读写分离地址

DBInstanceWeight.description_en: The list of read/write splitting weight information for the shared database proxy
DBInstanceWeight.description_zh: 共享代理的读写分离权重信息列表

items.description_en: The details of read/write splitting weight for the shared database proxy
items.description_zh: 共享代理的读写分离权重详情

Availability.description_en:
The availability status of the instance. Valid values:

Unavailable: unavailable.
Available: available
Availability.description_zh:
实例可用状态。返回值：

Unavailable：不可用。
Available：可用

DBInstanceType.description_en:
The instance type. Valid values:
Master: primary instance.
Readonly: read-only instance
DBInstanceType.description_zh:
实例类型。返回值：
Master：主实例。
Readonly：只读实例

Weight.description_en: The current weight of the instance

DistributionType.description_en:
The read request allocation policy of the shared database proxy. This parameter is returned only for read/write splitting connection endpoints. Valid values:

Standard: automatically allocates requests based on specification weights.
Custom: allocates requests based on custom weights
DistributionType.description_zh:
共享代理的读请求分配策略，只在读写分离连接地址返回该参数，取值：

Standard：按规格权重自动分配。
Custom：自定义分配权重

IPType.description_en:
The network type of the IP address. Valid values:

Public: Internet.
Inner: classic network.
Private: virtual private cloud (VPC)
IPType.description_zh:
IP地址的网络类型，返回值：

Public：公网。
Inner：经典网络。
Private：专有网络

MaxDelayTime.description_en:
The latency threshold of read-only instances for the shared database proxy. Unit: seconds.
This parameter is returned only when ConnectionStringType is set to ReadWriteSplitting
MaxDelayTime.description_zh:
共享代理的只读实例延迟阈值，单位：秒。
只在ConnectionStringType为ReadWriteSplitting时返回该参数

securityIPGroup.description_en: The list of IP whitelist groups of the instance
securityIPGroup.description_zh: 实例的IP白名单分组列表

items.description_en: The details of the IP whitelist group of the instance
items.description_zh: 实例的IP白名单分组详情

SecurityIPGroupName.description_en: The name of the IP whitelist group

SecurityIPs.description_en: The IP addresses in the whitelist

Upgradeable.description_en: An internal parameter. You can ignore this parameter

VPCId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the instance belongs
VPCId.description_zh: 实例所属的专有网络（VPC）的ID

VSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the instance belongs
VSwitchId.description_zh: 实例所属的虚拟交换机（vSwitch）ID

expiredTime.description_en: The remaining validity period of the classic network endpoint of the instance. Unit: seconds
expiredTime.description_zh: 实例经典网络地址的有效时间，单位：秒

InstanceNetworkType.description_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:
VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC).
Classic: classic network
InstanceNetworkType.description_zh:
实例网络类型。返回值：
VPC：专有网络。
Classic：经典网络
